version.approval_notes: Technical prototype, unlisted distribution. Matching TypeScript source and custom bundler are attached with every submission. Read .github/AMO_REVIEW.md in the source ZIP. BUILD_INFO.json at the ZIP root records exact OS, architecture, Node/npm/Python and locked tool versions. Rebuild: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build:offline. Output: dist-firefox-offline/. This pipeline uses scripts/build-offline.cjs, not WXT. Compare all output files byte-for-byte with the XPI, excluding Mozilla META-INF signatures. Offline tests use mocked APIs; Firefox real-device and Cloudflare live API/end-to-end functionality are not verified. Mozilla signing does not establish functional correctness. The preserved add-on ID is decision-formfill@local.example and the manifest version is 0.1.0.
